title: Inner compact exhaustion of an open set for lower integrals
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, O ⊆ ℝⁿ open, f : ℝⁿ → [0,∞] measurable, and M ∈ [0,∞]. If ∫⁻_L f dx ≤ M for every compact L ⊆ O, then ∫⁻_O f dx ≤ M (Lebesgue measure).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (O : Set (Rn n)) (f : Rn n → ℝ≥0∞) (M : ℝ≥0∞), IsOpen O → Measurable f → (∀ L, IsCompact L → L ⊆ O → ∫⁻ x in L, f x ≤ M) → ∫⁻ x in O, f x ≤ M
